purpose: Bounded signal-domain and exposure exploration; no reconstruction-quality or universal provider claim
pq_interpretation: Test convention only: one relative linear unit is 100 cd/m2; not an AMD requirement
hypothesis_tolerance_rationale: Broad fixed signal-domain discrimination on flat patch interiors, above half quantization; not a reconstruction-quality budget or calibrated acceptance threshold
hypothesis_policy: All numerical matches and failures are recorded. A completed integration profile does not accept every signal hypothesis or establish the internal operation order.
ordering_limit: An output whose internal exposure/transfer operations are reversed can preserve either candidate packing. Output invariance alone cannot identify the internal decode/pre-exposure order.
